summary: Translates a Winsock error code into a human-readable message string. When the passed value is -1 (the SOCKET_ERROR sentinel), fetches the real error code from WSAGetLastError; then a switch on the error code returns the corresponding static string. Unknown or unmapped codes fall back to a generic WSAGetLastError string.
